Question: Two banks, QuickLoan and FastFinance, offer personal loans with different compounding frequencies but the same nominal annual interest rate. QuickLoan compounds monthly at an APR of 6%, while FastFinance compounds semi-annually. If a borrower wants to minimize the effective cost of borrowing, which bank should they choose? Type: multiple-choice
Options:
    A. QuickLoan; because it has more frequent compounding periods.
    B. QuickLoan; due to its lower monthly period rate.
    C. FastFinance; since semi-annual compounding results in a lower EAR.
    D. FastFinance; as the annual percentage rate is identical to the effective annual rate.
    E. Both banks offer the same effective cost of borrowing regardless of compounding frequency.
